items.name: Dart
items.description: This thrown weapon is larger than an arrow but shorter than a javelin. It typically has a short shaft of wood ending in a metal tip and is sometimes stabilized by feathers or fur.

items.name: War Razor
items.description: A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool. It's a brittle but extremely sharp weapon that is very easy to slip into a pocket or sleeve.

items.name: Leather Apron (Functions as Leather Armor)
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Healer's Toolkit
items.description: This kit of bandages, herbs, and suturing tools is necessary for Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Administer First Aid], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Treat Disease], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Treat Poison], or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Treat Wounds]. If you wear your healer's toolkit, you can draw and replace its tools as part of the action that uses them.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blood and Fear
offensiveAbilities.description:
The interrogator Strikes with a slashing melee weapon. If they hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent bleed damage and is Frightened 1 (or 2d4 persistent bleed damage and Frightened 2 on a critical hit).

Each of the interrogator's other enemies in a 30ft Type:emanation around the target that witnesses the bloodshed must succeed at a DC 19 Will Saving Throw save or be frightened 1. The frightened part of this ability is an emotion, fear, mental, and visual effect.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hobble
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A creature is Grabbed or Restrained by the interrogator

Effect One creature grabbed or restrained by the interrogator takes 2d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage with a Basic DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw save. If the creature fails its save, it also gains a condition of the interrogator's choice: Clumsy 2 for 1 minute, Enfeebled 2 for 1 minute, or Drained 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Torment
offensiveAbilities.description: The interrogator's Strikes deal an additional 1d8 mental damage to Frightened creatures.
